subject: Execution Contract: B2B Client Research & Authority Verification Pipeline
body:
OBJECTIVE: Build verified enterprise client lists across logistics, retail, clean energy, and corporate sectors.
OUTPUT: Qualified client dossiers with verified MCA, ROC, GSTIN, and MSME Udyam credentials filed in `CLIENT_RESEARCH_DATABASE.md`.
TOOLS: Corporate registry search, GSTIN verification tools, MemPalace.
BOUNDARIES: Pass verified decision maker contacts to Andy (`client-closer`) via outbox.
